correctness.rationale: Near strictly interior minimizer t, unconstrained exact line searches are feasible and analytic; each vertex update derivative is the H-orthogonal projector P_i=I−n_i n_i^T H/(n_i^T H n_i). The 3-projector sweep has norm |c12 c23| in chosen order, trace c12 c23 c31 and J²=(trace J)J. With at most one orthogonal vertex pair, consecutive pair gives J=0 and quadratic one-sweep error; first/third orthogonal pair gives nonzero square-zero J and quadratic two-sweep error. The exceptional targets lie on the pair metric-circle interior arc iff opposite H-angle acute. Independently reconstructed exact rational example derivative J_(1,3,2)=[[1/5,-1/10],[2/5,-1/5]], J²=0 and J_(1,2,3)=0, and geometric circle identity; nonlinear quadratic expansions rely on source rational substitution.
